results.name: Leake Street Graffiti Tunnel
results.description:
The tunnel and arches below Waterloo Station, London that are completely coated in graffiti.

The graffiti began during the Cans Festival organised by Banksy on 3–5 May 2008.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leake_Street
https://www.leakestreetarches.london/

1732 photos taken on 3rd July 2020 with a Sony a6000 and processed in Agisoft Metashape.

results.name: Kannonzaki Battery Historic Site
results.description:
This is a photogrammetry of the remains of the Kannonzaki Battery No. 3 in Yokosuka City, Japan.
The site of a gun battery and the brick tunnel remain in Kannonzaki Park.
Two howitzers were installed in the mortar-shaped turret.

I attached a 20mm prime lens and a clip-on flash to a Sony A1 on a tripod and took 650 photos. The photos were taken on a lightly cloudy day, and the tunnel lighting and de-lighting the outside of the tunnel was done using flash light.

Location: https://goo.gl/maps/e15sdJR4pfKpTRvz8

results.name: Futatsugoya Tunnel “Abandoned road” japan
results.description:
# 土木学会選奨土木遺産　万世大路(二ツ小屋隧道)
# Japan Society of Civil Engineers Heritage
The road which connects Fukushima city, Fukushima prefecture to Yonezawa city, Yamagata prefecture was opened in 1881(明治14年) and named after “Banseitairo  Road” by the Emperor Meiji.Futatsugoya Tunnel is one of the two tunnels which are located in Banseitairo  Road. It was taken expansion work to motor vehicles can go through in 1934(昭和9年). In 1966(昭和41年), an another tunnel was opened at new place to they can go through if it has heavy snow and Banseitairo Road became the “Abandoned road” after finished its role.  

![Image from Gyazo](https://i.gyazo.com/6fee71412c237d0e8fdfa281128ac31a.jpg)  


3D digitizing methods : Photogrammetry  
Software : Reality Capture  
Equipment : Nikon D750,NIKKOR 16-35mm f/4G,SB-910  
Images:  1916 photos  
Date : Apr. 2020

results.name: Betsey Trotwood Pub
results.description:
The Betsey Trotwood pub on the corner of Farringdon Road and Farringdon Lane, London.

The pub is named after the character from David Copperfield by Charles Dickens. Betsey is David's Great Aunt and present at his birth.

The pub is particular interesting as it sits directly over the 'cut and cover' tunnel of the Metropolitan London Undeground line as well as (partly over) the lower tunnel of the Thameslink railway.

Date: 1865

https://www.betsey.pub/

624 photos taken in July 2020 with a Sony a6000 and processed in Reality Capture.
The roof area texture has been largely repainted due to photos being taken from ground level.

results.name: ( FREE ) Lamborghini Terzo Millennio Wind tunnel
results.description:
**Lamborghini Terzo Millennio (Wind tunnel) + Animation+Sound**

*The Lamborghini Terzo Millennio is a concept car under development, invented by Lamborghini, it adopts a carbon fiber body, which is able to store electricity (to replace the batteries and reduce the weight).*

The model was modeled with a wind tunnel, (which is used to study aerodynamics) the whole was inspired by a photo taken by Lamborghini, in the studio.

**Everything was done on Blender 2.9, download and free and royalty free;)**


NB: the rendering displayed on your screen (on sketchfab) may be different from that of Blender, I spent more time on that of Sketchfab.

results.name: Lights Shining in Darkness
results.description:
One day during my MRT commute, the tunnel lights were switched on. This is my rendition of the view I had that evening. That was like last month, real life be  kicking my butt really hard.

Animation is achieved by rotating a curved array of tunnel segments around a point (Inspired by some other entries I had found previously).

Modelled in Blender and textured in Substance Painter. Free to download but its really nothing fancy :)

results.name: Urban Series – Subway Section: Train Tunnel
results.description:
**Urban Series - Subway Section: Train Tunnel**

Subway Section: Train Tunnel is a conceptual 3D environment focused on urban infrastructure and spatial abstraction. The model reduces visual complexity to highlight structure, rhythm, and spatial perception, transforming a functional system into an experimental composition.
Part of the Urban Series, this asset reflects an ongoing exploration of modular systems, repetition, and perception in 3D space.

**Support**

If you need assistance or have any questions about the model, feel free to reach out via Instagram DM: @spazio_silvestre

**Potential Uses**

* Conceptual visualizations
* Motion graphics and animations
* Background environments
* Prototyping scenes
* Educational or experimental projects

**Project Approach**

This model is intentionally low in detail but strong in concept. It is designed as a flexible base that can be expanded, modified, or integrated into larger projects.

**Designer**

Luigi Maria di Silvestre — Spazio Silvestre
